seal.statement: Remove every production-reachable legacy consensus runtime and every active accommodation surface, leaving the raft-rs semantic operation port and runtime owner as Lagrange's only consensus implementation. MessageGroupService must construct the raft-rs port with durable local consensus state, derive committed membership from ConfState, publish role and leader from semantic status/events, propose and apply commands through the port, and restart without losing term, vote, or configuration. Every live RaftGroup and RaftReplicaBase consumer must either migrate to that boundary or be deleted when unreachable; process-level provider selection, distributed-harness provider vocabulary, migration/spike rollback tooling, the legacy dependency and implementation, legacy-only tests, and current documentation must be removed. A fixed-scope checker must reject case-insensitive legacy implementation references in filenames and contents across active surfaces while excluding only historical solve evidence. Before another five-node run, focused witnesses must prove message-group formation, proposal/commit, membership, restart, any retained generic/WASM consensus path, and zero active references.
